answer: Sybil resistance in an AI agent economy can employ a computational staking mechanism. Each agent must lock a substantial amount of scarce processing tokens, akin to a digital relic representing its validated identity. This resource pool secures a shared computational oasis. To launch a Sybil attack, an adversary would need to acquire and stake an equivalent quantity for every fake identity, making the cost prohibitively high and preventing malicious agents from simply letting fake personas wander unchecked through the network.
